title: Acceptance probability of a nonadaptive tester
statement: Let $T$ be a randomized nonadaptive tester with a finite seed space, a probability law on its seeds, and a deterministic acceptance rule. For a function $f$ from its domain to its codomain, its acceptance probability is the probability that the tester accepts the transcript obtained by answering each queried address using $f$.
hypotheses_covered: probability law on the seed space
query addresses fixed by the seed and transcript position
